title: A network interruption mid-upload resumes from the last acknowledged offset when the connection returns
asA: operator uploading through a spotty connection or a captive portal that drops mid-request
iWant: the transport to pause on interruption, wait for the connection to return, and resume from the last acknowledged offset without re-sending
soThat: a dropped connection does not force me to restart a large upload

acceptanceCriteria.description: On the ?interrupt=1 branch of the fixture the upload pauses after the first acknowledged chunk, the DOM exposes [data-file-state="paused"] and [data-chunks-uploaded] with a numeric value greater than zero on the paused row, and after the fixture resumes with ?resume=1 the row transitions to [data-file-state="complete"] with the accumulated [data-chunks-uploaded] equal to the total chunk count. The pack asserts no chunk index is re-uploaded (the fixture records the received offsets on the row and never repeats one).
